title: Kodiak Ultra Marathons history: Big Bear's 100-mile loop
claims: Kodiak started in 2013 as a locally organised 100-mile race around Big Bear Lake.
Vincent Bouillard won the 2023 100-mile in 16:22:08, taking more than three hours off the previous course record, and Claire Bannwarth won the women's race in 21:10:28.
Sam Wood won the 2024 race in 18:24:08 and Kristina Chang won the women's race in 21:15:24.
Hayden Hawks won the 2025 race in 16:40:37, the second-fastest time in race history; Lin Chen set a women's course record of 19:31:17.
The 2026 100-mile route is described as 161.4 km with 4,876 m of climbing and 15 checkpoints.
